finalUrl.title: Final URL
finalUrl.description: Present only when the URL redirected.

ok.description: True when the link works: a 2xx answer, directly or after redirects. False for anything else, including a 403 where we cannot tell.

status.title: Status
status.description: ok, redirected, blocked, broken, server-error, soft-error, insecure or unreachable. Filter on this. "blocked" is a 401/403/429, which usually means bot protection turned the checker away rather than the link being dead.

broken.title: Broken
broken.description: True for anything a visitor would experience as a dead link: 4xx, 5xx, unreachable hosts, soft 404s and rejected certificates. Deliberately false for "blocked", so bot protection does not fill the report with false alarms.

redirects.title: Redirect chain
redirects.description: Each hop with the URL, its status code and where it pointed.

redirectChain.title: Chain summary
redirectChain.description: How many hops, whether it loops, whether https downgrades to http anywhere, and whether it ends on a different host.

softError.title: Soft 404
softError.description: Present when the page answered 200 but reads as an error page, with the reason it was judged so.

certificate.title: Certificate
certificate.description: Issuer, subject, validity dates, days until expiry, and whether a browser would accept it, when certificate checking is on.

foundOn.title: Found on
foundOn.description: The page this link was taken from, in crawl mode.

anchor.title: Anchor text
anchor.description: The clickable text, so a report can name the link a person has to fix.

external.description: Whether the link pointed off the crawled site.
